description: Scaffold the Angular 19 project in the existing repository directory using Angular CLI. This sets up the foundational project structure including routing, standalone components, and all configuration files.
steps: Run 'npx @angular/cli@19 new kiro-sample-angular-app --directory . --skip-git --style=css --routing --ssr=false' inside /projects/sandbox/kiro-sample-angular-app to scaffold the Angular project without overwriting the .git directory.
Verify the scaffold succeeded by checking that angular.json, package.json, tsconfig.json, and src/app/app.component.ts exist.
Run 'npm install' to ensure all dependencies are installed.
Run 'npx ng build' to verify the production build succeeds.

Install chromium for headless testing: run 'npx puppeteer browsers install chrome' or configure Karma to use ChromeHeadless. Update karma.conf.js if needed to add ChromeHeadless as a browser and set CHROME_BIN environment variable.

Run 'npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless' to verify tests pass. If Karma tests fail due to missing Chrome, adjust the approach: either install chromium via the system package manager or switch to a headless-compatible setup.
Update the README.md to describe the Angular Bookstore application with setup instructions, features overview, and how to run the app.
acceptance_criteria: 'npx ng build' completes successfully with no errors
'npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless' passes (or tests are confirmed working with an alternative headless browser setup)
The project structure follows Angular 19 conventions with standalone components
README.md is updated with project description and instructions
